bundle.longDescription: OpenDemand is a local-first, SKU-level demand forecasting desktop application. Import a canonical CSV or convert a raw SAP, Subiekt, Comarch, or Excel export with the guided import, forecast with three models (Naive, SeasonalNaive and AutoETS) and automatic selection of the best model for each series, then review and override the plan. All data stays on your machine.
